reasoning: 1. TARGET ENGAGEMENT: Strong evidence - plasma concentrations achieved therapeutic levels (11-23 ng/mL), confirming GSK1120212 reached and engaged MEK1/2. 2. PATHWAY MODULATION: No explicit downstream biomarker data reported, but target engagement at therapeutic levels suggests pathway modulation occurred. 3. CLINICAL TRANSLATION: Mixed results - cohort B (BRAF inhibitor-naive) achieved 25% ORR with success outcome, while cohort A (prior BRAF inhibitor) had 0% ORR with failure outcome. The primary endpoint was met overall. 4. POPULATION EFFECTS: Clear differential response - patients with prior BRAF inhibitor exposure had 0% response vs 25% in BRAF inhibitor-naive patients. BRAF V600E patients showed 26% ORR. 5. CONFOUNDERS: No major trial design issues - adequate sample size, appropriate duration, no dose-limiting toxicity preventing target engagement.

failure_modes.evidence: Clear differential efficacy: 25% ORR in BRAF inhibitor-naive patients (cohort B) vs 0% ORR in patients with prior BRAF inhibitor exposure (cohort A). The mechanism works but is limited to treatment-naive population.
